meta.title: Nexolume: offline Writer, Sheets and Slides
meta.description: A Windows office suite that keeps your documents on your computer. Writer, Sheets and Slides, with no account and no connection.

hero.title: Nexolume
hero.lead: The Windows office suite that works offline: Writer, Sheets and Slides, with no account.

items.sentence: Your files stay on this PC.
items.consequence: No account to create, no connection: 0 bytes sent.
Comments and tracked changes are kept in both formats.

items.sentence: Sheets recalculates when a cell changes.
items.consequence: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT and the + - * / operators follow cell dependencies.

items.sentence: Slides starts the show with F5.
items.consequence: Full screen from the start, one undo step per drag.
Corrections arrive while you type, without leaving the page.

showcase.title: Writer and Sheets, side by side

writer.name: Writer
lines: The quarter's figures live in Sheets. They recalculate as soon as a cell changes.
The presentation is waiting for the last screenshots.

open.title: Drop a file.
open.lead: The file stays in your browser: nothing is sent.

drop.unsupported: is not a format Nexolume opens.

rows.text: Word: text, styles, tables, images, comments and tracked changes. Opens and saves.
OpenDocument: the same elements, with annotations and tracked changes. Opens and saves.
Nexolume's native format, in versioned JSON. Opens and saves.
Native workbook, with formulas and formats. Opens and saves.
Native presentation, with slides and shapes. Opens and saves.

open.caveat: Advanced objects in Word files are kept when you save, but their display stays simplified.

limits.title: Not yet in the alpha
items: Undo history is not kept after closing.
Advanced Word objects display in a simplified way.

steps.clause: Download the ZIP archive of version 0.1.0-alpha.
Extract the whole ZIP before you start the program.

cta.text: Windows x64. The ZIP comes from this project's GitHub releases page.
